card.name: Just before kidney-toxicity words
card.fires_on: Words right before a kidney term such as nephrotoxicity, nephritis or renal impairment. Often a linking word like AND or OR after neurotoxic, or the start of a split word like glomerulonephritis.

modes.label: Linking word after neurotoxic
modes.description: AND, OR or a similar link between neurotoxic and a coming nephrotoxic term.
modes.example: THE CONCURRENT OR SEQUENTIAL USE OF OTHER NEUROTOXIC<< AND>>/OR NEPHROTOXIC DRUG

modes.label: Inside nephritis or glomerulonephritis
modes.description: The letter or piece just before the neph/nephritis ending of a split word.
modes.example: 5.2 Acute Interstitial<< N>>ephritis Acute interstitial nephritis

modes.label: Toxicity statement leading to renal
modes.description: A verb or adverb in a toxicity statement just before renal impairment is named.

card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name kidney damage, often after a mention of nerve toxicity.
